verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              ततस्ते तापसाः सर्वे कार्यवन्तोऽभवंस्तदा। तां कन्यां चिन्तयन्तस्ते किं कार्यमिति धर्मिणः ॥१॥
verses.english: Bhishma said Then did all those anchorites engage themselves in their respective duties and those virtuous ones thought as to what they should do for that lady.
verses.bhavadeepa: दृष्टान्तो लौकिकोदाहरणम् । आगमो वेदः हेतुर्युक्तिस्तैः प्रारब्धकर्मभोगस्यापरिहार्यत्वं ज्ञात्वा समाश्वस्ता भवेत्युक्तेत्यर्थः ॥४५॥

verses.sanskrit: केचिदाहुः पितुर्वेश्म नीयतामिति तापसाः। केचिदस्मदुपालम्भे मतिं चक्रुर्हि तापसाः ॥२॥
verses.english: Some among them then said “Let us take her to her father's place," and some of the anchorites thought of finding fault with ourselves.

verses.sanskrit: केचिच्छाल्वपतिं गत्वा नियोज्यमिति मेनिरे। नेति केचिद्व्यवस्यन्ति प्रत्याख्याता हि तेन सा ॥३॥
verses.english: Some thought of going to the king of the Shalvas and ask him to accept the girl: some said 'nay' to this proposal for she was rejected by him.

verses.sanskrit: एवं गते तु किं शक्यं भद्रे कर्तुं मनीषिभिः। पुनरूचुश्च तां सर्वे तापसाः संशितव्रताः ॥४॥
verses.english: Then did all those anchorites say again to her:-It being so, gentle lady, what can these anchorites do for you, endued with intelligence and self-control though they are?

verses.sanskrit: अलं प्रव्रजितेनेह भद्रे शृणु हितं वचः। इतो गच्छस्व भद्रं ते पितुरेव निवेशनम् ॥५॥
verses.english: There is no need for you to roam about in these woods: Listen to wards that are of benefit to you and go hence to your father's place; may you fare well.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपत्स्यति राजा स पिता ते यदनन्तरम्। तत्र वत्स्यसि कल्याणि सुखं सर्वगुणान्विता ॥६॥
verses.english: The king, your father, will do what is proper for you and, O blessed lady, you will live there in happiness, endued with all accomplishments as you are.

verses.sanskrit: न च तेऽन्या गतिर्न्याय्या भवेद्भद्रे यथा पिता। पतिर्वाऽपि गतिर्नार्याः पिता वा वरवर्णिनि ॥७॥
verses.english: There is no other proper refuge for you, O gentle lady, save your father; for either the father or the husband is the refuge of a woman, O you or fair complexion.

verses.sanskrit: गतिः पतिः समस्थाया विषमे च पिता गतिः। प्रव्रज्या हि सुदुःखेयं सुकुमार्या विशेषतः ॥८॥
verses.english: A husband is a woman's refuge under smoother circumstances and in a difficult situation a father is the refuge; roaming about is a hard task, especially for those brought up in luxury.

verses.sanskrit: राजपुत्र्याः प्रकृत्या च कुमार्यास्तव भामिनि। भद्रे दोषा हि विद्यन्ते बहवो वरवर्णिनि ॥९॥
verses.english: Being a princess, you are naturally delicate, O romantic lady; there are many disadvantages, O you of beautiful complexion,

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमे वै वसन्त्यास्ते न भवेयुः पितुर्गुहे। ततस्त्वन्येऽब्रुवन् वाक्यं तापसास्तां तपस्विनीम् ॥१०॥
verses.english: In a life in the hermitage while there will be none in your father's place. Then did other anchorites say to that female devotee these

verses.sanskrit: त्वामिहैकाकिनीं दृष्ट्वा निर्जने गहने वने। प्रार्थयिष्यन्ति राजानस्तस्मान्मैवं मनः कृथाः ॥११॥
verses.english: Seeing yourself alone in these dreary and solitary woods kings will court you; therefore do not set your heart on such a life.
verses.bhavadeepa: ये दोषा विद्यन्ते आश्रमे प्रव्रज्यायां ते दोषाः पितुर्गृहे न भवेयुः । सुंदरीं तरुणीं च त्वां दृष्ट्वा मुनयो वा मोहं प्राप्स्यन्ति त्वं वा धर्मात् स्खलिष्यसीति भावः ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: अम्बोवाच। न शक्यं काशिनगरं पुनर्गन्तुं पितुर्गुहान्। अवज्ञाता भविष्यामि बान्धवानां न संशयः ॥१२॥
verses.english: Amba said I cannot go to the city of Kashi to my father's place for I shall doubtless to disgraced by my friends.

verses.sanskrit: उषिताऽस्मि तथा बाल्ये पितुर्वेश्मनि तापसाः। नाहं गमिष्ये भद्रं वस्तत्र यत्र पिता मम। तपस्तप्तुमभीप्सामि तापसैः परिरक्षिता ॥१३॥
verses.english: O ascetics, in my childhood did I live in my father's place but now I shall not go where my father is; may you fare well.

verses.sanskrit: यथा परेऽपि मे लोके न स्यादेवं महात्ययः। दौर्भाग्यं तापसश्रेष्ठास्तस्मात्तप्स्याम्यहं तपः ॥१४॥
verses.english: I desire to practice asceticism protected by anchorites so that in the next world too I may not meet with such dire calamities. O foremost among ascetics, therefore am I desirous of practicing asceticism.

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              इत्येवं तेषु विप्रेषु चिन्तयत्सु यथातथम्। राजर्षिस्तद्वनं प्राप्तस्तपस्वी होत्रवाहनः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Bhishma said While those regenerate persons were thus thinking of the merit of the case, the royal sage Hotravahana came into that forest.
verses.bhavadeepa: महात्ययः सुखनाशः । ‘मह उद्धव उत्सवः’ इति कोशः ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते तापसाः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म तं नृपम्। पूजाभिः स्वागताद्याभिरासनेनोदकेन च ॥१६॥
verses.english: Then did all those ascetics worship that ruler of men and welcome him with their greetings, seat and water.

verses.sanskrit: तस्योपविष्टस्य सतो विश्रान्तस्योपशृण्वतः। पुनरेव कथां चक्रुः कन्यां प्रति वनौकसः ॥१७॥
verses.english: Then did those dwellers of the forest again address that lady in the hearing of that sage after he had taken his seat and rested himself a little.

verses.sanskrit: अम्बायास्तां कथां श्रुत्वा काशिराज्ञश्च भारत। राजर्षिः स महातेजा बभूवोद्विग्नमानसः ॥१८॥
verses.english: Hearing those words of Amba, the daughter of the king of the Kashis, O Bharata, that royal sage of great energy became filled with pity.

verses.sanskrit: तां तथावादिनीं श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा च स महातपाः। राजर्षिः कृपयाऽऽविष्टो महात्मा होत्रवाहनः ॥१९॥
verses.english: That king of great austerities, the greatsouled royal sage Hotravahana, seeing her and hearing her speak in that way, became filled with pity.

verses.sanskrit: स वेपमान उत्थाय मातुस्तस्याः पिता तदा। तां कन्यामङ्कमारोप्य पर्यश्वासयत प्रभो ॥२०॥
verses.english: The father of her mother then rose trembling (with rage) and placing her on his lap began to comfort her.

verses.sanskrit: स तामपृच्छत् कार्स्न्येन व्यसनोत्पत्तिमादितः। सा च तस्मै यथावृत्तं विस्तरेण न्यवेदयत् ॥२१॥
verses.english: He asked her the story of her wrongs from its origin and in detail and she too submitted to him everything as it had happened in detail.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स राजर्षिरभूद्दुःखशोकसमन्वितः। कार्यं च प्रतिपेदे तन्मनसा सुमहातपाः ॥२२॥
verses.english: Then was that royal sage filled with grief and distress and that one of great asceticism resolved, within himself, on his course of action.

verses.sanskrit: अब्रवीद्वेपमानश्च कन्यामार्तां सुदुःखितः। मा गाः पितुर्गृहं भद्रे मातुस्ते जनको ह्यहम् ॥२३॥
verses.english: Trembling, he said to that distressed and sorrowful girl: "Do not go to your father's place, gentle lady. I am the father of your mother.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखं छिन्द्यामहं ते वै मयि वर्तस्व पुत्रिके। पर्याप्तं ते मनो वत्से यदेवं परिशुष्यसि ॥२४॥
verses.english: I shall remove your sorrow, depend on me, dear daughter. You have enough of grief, child, since you are so lean.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ मद्वचनाद्रामं जामदग्न्यं तपस्विनम्। रामस्ते सुमहद्दुःखं शोकं चैवापनेष्यति ॥२५॥
verses.english: By my advice go to the ascetic Rama, the son of Jamadagni. Rama will remove this heavy and horrible grief of yours.

verses.sanskrit: हनिष्यति रणे भीष्मं न करिष्यति चेद्वचः। तं गच्छ भार्गवश्रेष्ठं कालाग्निसमतेजसम् ॥२६॥
verses.english: He will slay Bhishma in battle if he does not act up to his words; go to him, that foremost of the Bhrigu race, who, in energy, is equal to the fire that rages at the time of the universal destruction.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठापयिता स त्वां स मे पथि महातपाः। ततस्तु सुस्वरं बाष्पमुत्सृजन्ती पुनः पुनः ॥२७॥
verses.english: That great anchorite will place you on the even path.” Then shedding tears profusely,

verses.sanskrit: अब्रवीत् पितरं मातुः सा तदा होत्रवाहनम्। अभिवादयित्वा शिरसा गमिष्ये तव शासनात् ॥२८॥
verses.english: And saluting with her head the father of her mother, Hotravahana, she said "By your command I shall go there.

verses.sanskrit: अपि नामाद्य पश्येयमार्यं तं लोकविश्रुतम्। कथं च तीव्रं दुःखं मे नाशयिष्यति भार्गवः। एतदिच्छाम्यहं ज्ञातुं यथा यास्यामि तत्र वै ॥२९॥
verses.english: But shall I be able to see that respected man known throughout the world and how shall he of Bhrigu's race remove my grave sorrow? I desire to know this since I am going there.

verses.sanskrit:
होत्रवाहन उवाच।
              रामं द्रक्ष्यसि भद्रे त्वं जामदग्न्यं महावने। उग्रे तपसि वर्तन्तं सत्यसन्धं महाबलम् ॥३०॥
verses.english: Hotravahana said “You will see Rama, the son of Jamadagni, devoted to truth and endued with great strength in the great forest, practicing hard asceticism.

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रं वै गिरिश्रेष्ठं रामो नित्यमुपास्ति ह। ऋषयो वेदविद्वांसो गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा ॥३१॥
verses.english: Rama ever dwells on that highest among the mountains, called Mahendra. Rishis conversant with the Vedas and Gandharavas and Apsaras also live there.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गच्छस्व भद्रं ते ब्रूयाश्चैनं वचो मम। अभिवाद्य च तं मूर्ध्ना तपोवृद्धं दृढव्रतम् ॥३२॥
verses.english: Go there and may you fare well. Tell him these words of mine after saluting that old devotee of firm vows by bowing down your head.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूयाश्चैनं पुनर्भद्रे यत्ते कार्यं मनीषितम्। मयि संकीर्तिते रामः सर्वं तत्ते करिष्यति ॥३३॥
verses.english: Tell him what you want, gentle ladyhearing my name Rama will do all you ask of him.

verses.sanskrit: मम रामः सखा वत्से प्रीतियुक्तः सुहृच्च मे। जमदग्निसुतो वीरः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ॥३४॥
verses.english: Rama is my friend, child, and he is my well-wisher and is highly pleased with me that hero, the son Jamadagni and the foremost of all wielders of weapons.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवति कन्यां तु पार्थिवे होत्रवाहने। अकृतव्रणः प्रादुरासीद्रामस्यानुचरः प्रियः ॥३५॥
verses.english: While Hotravahana that ruler of the earth was thus speaking to that girl, the devoted follower of Rama, Akritavrana, presented himself there.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे समुत्तस्थुः सहस्रशः। स च राजा वयोवृद्धः सृञ्जयो होत्रवाहनः ॥३६॥
verses.english: Then did all those Rishis by thousands as also Hotravahana, the king of the Srinjayas, old in years, stand up.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दृष्ट्वा कृतातिथ्यमन्योन्यं ते वनौकसः। सहिता भरतश्रेष्ठ निषेदुः परिवार्य तम् ॥३७॥
verses.english: Seeing him those dwellers of the forest united together did him the rites of hospitality and then sat down surrounding him, O chief among the Bharatas.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते कथयामासुः कथास्तास्ता मनोरमाः। धन्या दिव्याश्च राजेन्द्र प्रीतिहर्षमुदा युताः ॥३८॥
verses.english: Then they began to converse cheerfully and delightfully on subjects that delighted one's heart and which were blessed and divine, O chief among kings.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कथान्ते राजर्षिर्महात्मा होत्रवाहनः। रामं श्रेष्ठं महर्षीणामपृच्छदकृतव्रणम् ॥३९॥
verses.english: Then at the end of the conversation, the royal sage Hotravahana, endued with a large soul, asked Akritavrana about Rama the foremost among the great Rishis.

verses.sanskrit: क्व संप्रति महाबाहो जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्। अकृतव्रण शक्यो वै द्रष्टुं वेदविदां वर ॥४०॥
verses.english: “Where can I see at present the mighty son of Jamadagni, O you of long arms, 0 Akritavrana, that foremost among those conversant with the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit:
अकृतव्रण उवाच।
              भवन्तमेव सततं रामः कीर्तयति प्रभो। सृञ्जयो मे प्रियसखो राजर्षिरिति पार्थिव ॥४१॥
verses.english: Akritavrana said Rama ever speaks of you, my lord, saying: The royal sage Srinjaya, that ruler of the earth, is my dear friend.

verses.sanskrit: इह रामः प्रभाते श्वो भवितेति मतिर्मम। द्रष्टाऽस्येनमिहायान्तं तव दर्शनकाङ्क्षया ॥४२॥
verses.english: I think Rama will be here on the morrow. You will see him come here owing to your desire for seeing him.

verses.sanskrit: इयं च कन्या राजर्षे किमर्थं वनमागता। कस्य चेयं तव च का भवतीच्छामि वेदितुम् ॥४३॥
verses.english: O royal sage, why is the lady come to the forest, whose daughter is she and what is she to you? I desire to know it.

verses.sanskrit:
होत्रवाहन उवाच।
              दौहित्रीयं मम विभो काशिराजसुता प्रिया। ज्येष्ठा स्वयंवरे तस्थौ भगिनीभ्यां सहानघ ॥४४॥
verses.english: Hotravahana said She is my grand child, my lord, the beloved daughter of the king of the Kashis. O sinless one, she was desirous of choosing her own husband along with her two sisters.

verses.sanskrit: इयमम्बेति विख्याता ज्येष्ठा काशिपतेः सुता। अम्बिकाम्बालिके कन्ये कनीयस्यौ तपोधन ॥४५॥
verses.english: This eldest daughter of the ruler of the Kashis is known as Amba and, O you whose only wealth is devotion, his two younger daughters are called Ambika and Ambalika.

verses.sanskrit: समेतं पार्थिवं क्षत्रं काशिपुर्यां ततोऽभवत्। कन्यानिमित्तं विप्रर्षे तत्रासीदुत्सवो महान् ॥४६॥
verses.english: Then was there assembled in the city of Kashi, the entire body of Kshatriya rulers of the earth and there were great rejoicing there, O regenerate Rishi of those princes.

verses.sanskrit: ततः किल महावीर्यो भीष्मः शान्तनवो नृपान्। अधिक्षिप्य महातेजास्तिस्त्रः कन्या जहार ताः ॥४७॥
verses.english: Then did Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, endued with great heroism and energy overthrowing all those rulers of the earth, take away the three girls by force.

verses.sanskrit: निर्जित्य पृथिवीपालानथ भीष्मो गजाह्वयम्। आजगाम विशुद्धात्मा कन्याभिः सह भारतः ॥४८॥
verses.english: Bhishma of sinless soul, having conquered those rulers of the earth came to the city called after the elephant in company with those girls, OBharata.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यवत्यै निवेद्याथ विवाहं समनन्तरम्। भ्रातुर्विचित्रवीर्यस्य समाज्ञापयत प्रभुः ॥४९॥
verses.english: That lord after submitting the case to Satyavati ordered for the wedding of his brother Vichitravirya.

verses.sanskrit: तं तु वैवाहिकं दृष्ट्वा कन्येयं समुपार्जितम्। अब्रवीत्तत्र गाङ्गेयं मन्त्रिमध्ये द्विजर्षभ ॥५०॥
verses.english: This girl, seeing all the arrangements made for the wedding, said there to the son of Ganga in the midst of his councillors, O best among the twice-born.

verses.sanskrit: मया शाल्वपतिर्वीरो मनसाऽभिवृतः पतिः। न मामर्हसि धर्मज्ञ दातुं भ्रात्रेऽन्यमानसाम् ॥५१॥
verses.english: The heroic king of Shalva has been chosen by me as my husband; O you conversant with virtue, it is not proper that you should give me, who am desirous of another, up in your brother.
verses.bhavadeepa: तं विचित्रवीर्यं वैवाहिकं विवाहार्थमुद्यतं समुपार्जितम् अभ्यङ्गकौतुकबन्धादिना संस्कृतं दृष्ट्वा इयं कन्या गाङ्गेयमब्रवीदिति योजना  ॥५०॥

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं भीष्मः संमन्त्र्य सह मन्त्रिभिः। निश्चित्य विससर्जेमां सत्यवत्या मते स्थितः ॥५२॥
verses.english: Bhishma, hearing those words and consulting with his ministers, came to a decision and following the opinion of Satyavati sent her away,

verses.sanskrit: अनुज्ञाता तु भीष्मेण शाल्वं सौभपतिं ततः। कन्येयं मुदिता तत्र काले वचनमब्रवीत् ॥५३॥
verses.english: Permitted by Bhishma this girl rejoicing went to Shalva the lord of Saubha in due time and said these words:

verses.sanskrit: विसर्जिताऽस्मि भीष्मेण धर्मं मां प्रतिपादय। मनसाऽभिवृतः पूर्वं मया त्वं पार्थिवर्षभ ॥५४॥
verses.english: I have been dismissed by Bhishma; act righteously towards me for you had before been chosen by me as my husband, O best among the rulers of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्याचख्यौ च शाल्वोऽस्याश्चारित्रस्याभिशङ्कितः। सेयं तपोवनं प्राप्ता तापस्येऽभिरता भृशम् ॥५५॥
verses.english: Shalva, however being suspicious about her character, rejected her and she, coming to this hermitage, has become greatly bent on practicing asceticism.

verses.sanskrit: मया च प्रत्यभिज्ञाता वंशस्य परिकीर्तनात्। अस्य दुःखस्य चोत्पत्तिं भीष्ममेवेह मन्यते ॥५६॥
verses.english: She was recognized by me owing to her describing her parentage and she thinks Bhishma as the origin of this calamity of hers.

verses.sanskrit: अम्बोवाच। भगवन्नेवमेवेह यथाऽऽह पृथिवीपतिः। शरीरकर्ता मातुर्मे सृञ्जयो होत्रवाहनः ॥५७॥
verses.english: Amba said O lord, it is even as this ruler of the earth has said; the progenitor of my mother's self is this Hotravahana of the Srinjaya race.

verses.sanskrit: न ह्युत्सहे स्वनगरं प्रतियातुं तपोधन। अपमानभयाच्चैव व्रीडया च महामुने ॥५८॥
verses.english: I do not desire to go back to my father's city, O you whose wealth consists in asceticism, from fear of disgrace and out of shame, O great Muni.

verses.sanskrit: यत्तु मां भगवान् रामो वक्ष्यति द्विजसत्तम। तन्मे कार्यतमं कार्यमिति मे भगवन्मतिः ॥५९॥
verses.english: 0 best among the twice-born, it is my opinion that what the lord Rama points out to me would be my supreme duty, my lord.
